notes: A plain tabular listing: a title, a run date, a six-column table with a ruled heading row and twenty records, and a footer carrying the page number. This is the most common report shape a DevExpress shop migrates, and the case that exercises the per-record Detail band rather than a one-off document. The footer's Page 1 of 1 is there so the page-number rule (XRPageInfo in the PageFooter, see repxAudit.ts) is measured and not assumed. The expected phrases are headings and chrome only, no record values: a banded report carries one Detail row, so a customer name from the source is not a phrase the REPX should contain, and the first baseline (2026-10-28) showed the one successful run failing on exactly that.
